title: A principal-only repayment on a loan marked charged off credits INCOME_FROM_RECOVERY 500.00 then debits the resolved fund source 1 exactly ONCE (loan 37 L125)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a REPAYMENT posted on a loan ALREADY MARKED CHARGED OFF under createJournalEntriesForRepaymentWhenLoanIsChargedOff, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1 / loanProductId 2, loan 37 chargedOff true, fraud false) at repayment transaction L125. request.charged_off_repayment_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's repayment transaction id 125 (type loanTransactionType.repayment, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 5): principalPortion 500.0 -> "50000"; interest/fee/penalty/overpayment 0 and omitted. The repayment is preceded in the read-back by the loan's NON-REVERSED chargeOff transaction id 124, so the loan is already marked charged off when L125 posts. request.charged_off_repayment_journal.accounts is the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP1.json's accountingMappings with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel: incomeFromRecoveryAccountId 17 (Recoveries), loanPortfolioAccountId 6, receivableInterestAccountId 10, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 16, fundSourceAccountId 1; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 18, so paymentType 5 has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 1. expect.charged_off_repayment_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L125 legs in id order from the journal-entries read-back: JE 372 CREDIT glAccountId 17 500.00, JE 373 DEBIT glAccountId 1 500.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a repayment on a charged-off loan CREDITS the principal to INCOME_FROM_RECOVERY, not to the loan portfolio the ordinary branch uses, then DEBITs the total exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source. The single principal credit is what discriminates the account cell on the fraud=false product LP1: a port that posts the repayment like an ordinary one leaves the amount, the side and the single fund-source debit unchanged and moves only the credit's account from 17 to the loan portfolio 6. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive interest, fee, penalty or overpayment portion (all zero here — the principal+interest loan-19 vector grades the merged-credit branch); the fraud flag's effect (none — this branch never reads it, and the fraud=true loan-19 observation shares account 17); the method's unobserved merchant-issued-refund, payout-refund, goodwill-credit and else branches (no transaction-type input exists). The journal-entries read-back holds only these two legs for L125, both reversed false, so no later reversal is mixed in. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
